rationale_1: Drastically reduces the number of trainable parameters in self.fc1 and self.fc, minimizing both RAM footprint and energy consumption during gradient updates.

recommendation_4: Apply L1 Unstructured Pruning to self.fc1 with amount=0.4 followed immediately by prune.remove.
rationale_4: Eliminates 40% of redundant connections in the largest layer, reducing the model size for Flower state_dict transmission and lowering energy cost.

rationale_5: Further optimizes the output layer sparsity to ensure the most compact memory footprint possible before server synchronization.
